url: Official Joplin documentation (joplinapp.org) and in-app menus
description: Hand-verified capability inventory for Joplin (net.cozic.joplin), version 3.6.21.

features.name: Create a notebook
features.description: Create a notebook as documented for Joplin.

features.name: Create a nested sub-notebook
features.description: Create a nested sub-notebook as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap "Edit"/move option and set the parent, or create a new notebook and then long-press it

features.name: Rename or delete a notebook
features.description: Rename or delete a notebook as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap "Edit" to rename it and tap Save, or tap "Delete" and confirm

features.name: Create a note
features.description: Create a note as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap the back arrow or the tick to save

features.name: Create a to-do
features.description: Create a to-do as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap back to save; the item appears with a checkbox in the note list

features.name: Mark a to-do as completed
features.description: Mark a to-do as completed as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap the checkbox beside the to-do; completed to-dos are struck through and can be hidden through the sort/filter options

features.name: Convert a note to a to-do and back
features.description: Convert a note to a to-do and back as documented for Joplin.

features.name: Set an alarm on a to-do
features.description: Set an alarm on a to-do as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap Save; a notification fires at that time

features.name: Write in Markdown with live syntax highlighting
features.description: Write in Markdown with live syntax highlighting as documented for Joplin.
actions: Open a note in the Markdown editor
type Markdown syntax (headings, lists, links, code fences, tables)
the editor highlights the syntax as you type

features.name: Use the Markdown formatting toolbar
features.description: Use the Markdown formatting toolbar as documented for Joplin.
actions: Open a note in the editor
use the toolbar above the keyboard to insert bold, italic, headings, lists, checkboxes, links, code and horizontal rules at the cursor

features.name: Switch between the Markdown editor and the rich text (WYSIWYG) editor
features.description: Switch between the Markdown editor and the rich text (WYSIWYG) editor as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap the editor toggle icon in the toolbar (or set the default in Settings
the note reopens in the other editing mode

features.name: Switch between edit mode and the rendered viewer
features.description: Switch between edit mode and the rendered viewer as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap the eye/edit toggle in the toolbar
tap the pencil to go back to editing

features.name: Attach a photo taken with the camera
features.description: Attach a photo taken with the camera as documented for Joplin.
actions: Open a note in edit mode
confirm; the image is embedded as a resource

features.name: Attach an image or file from the device
features.description: Attach an image or file from the device as documented for Joplin.
actions: select the item from the picker

features.name: Record and attach audio
features.description: Record and attach audio as documented for Joplin.

features.name: Use voice typing to dictate note text
features.description: Use voice typing to dictate note text as documented for Joplin.
actions: Open a note in edit mode
tap the voice typing (microphone) icon in the toolbar
download the language model if prompted
tap stop; the transcription is inserted at the cursor

features.name: Attach the current geolocation to a note
features.description: Attach the current geolocation to a note as documented for Joplin.
actions: Enable the geolocation option in Settings
tap "Attach geolocation"/"Show note location" as available

features.name: Add tags to a note
features.description: Add tags to a note as documented for Joplin.
actions: type a new tag or select existing tags

features.name: Browse notes by tag
features.description: Browse notes by tag as documented for Joplin.
actions: the note list shows all notes carrying that tag

features.name: Search notes
features.description: Search notes as documented for Joplin.
actions: Tap the search icon in the toolbar
type the query (supports Joplin search syntax such as tag:, notebook:, title: and created:)
tap a result to open it

features.name: Sort the note list
features.description: Sort the note list as documented for Joplin.
actions: choose the field (updated date, created date, title or custom order) and the direction

features.name: Reorder notes manually
features.description: Reorder notes manually as documented for Joplin.
actions: Set the sort order to custom
long-press a note in the list
drag it to the required position

features.name: Move a note to another notebook
features.description: Move a note to another notebook as documented for Joplin.

features.name: Duplicate a note
features.description: Duplicate a note as documented for Joplin.

features.name: Delete a note
features.description: Delete a note as documented for Joplin.
actions: Open the note (or long-press it in the list)
confirm; the note moves to the trash

features.name: Restore notes from the trash
features.description: Restore notes from the trash as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap Restore, or tap the permanent delete action to purge it

features.name: Configure synchronisation with a remote target
features.description: Configure synchronisation with a remote target as documented for Joplin.
actions: choose the sync target (Joplin Cloud, Joplin Server, Dropbox, OneDrive, Nextcloud/WebDAV, AWS S3 or the local file system)
enter the credentials or complete the OAuth login

features.name: Run a synchronisation manually
features.description: Run a synchronisation manually as documented for Joplin.
actions: the sync progress is shown in the sidebar

features.name: Set the automatic synchronisation interval
features.description: Set the automatic synchronisation interval as documented for Joplin.
actions: also set whether syncing over mobile data is allowed

features.name: Enable end-to-end encryption
features.description: Enable end-to-end encryption as documented for Joplin.
actions: confirm; run a sync so the encrypted data is uploaded

features.name: Enter a master key password to decrypt synced notes
features.description: Enter a master key password to decrypt synced notes as documented for Joplin.

features.name: Publish/share a note (Joplin Cloud account required)
features.description: Publish/share a note (Joplin Cloud account required) as documented for Joplin.
actions: Log in to Joplin Cloud in the synchronisation settings

features.name: Lock the app with a PIN or biometrics
features.description: Lock the app with a PIN or biometrics as documented for Joplin.

features.name: Change the application theme
features.description: Change the application theme as documented for Joplin.
actions: select the theme (light, dark, dracula, solarized, Nord, aritim dark and so on)
optionally enable the automatic light/dark switch

features.name: Change the editor and viewer font size
features.description: Change the editor and viewer font size as documented for Joplin.
actions: set the editor font size and the note viewer font size

features.name: Enable Markdown rendering plugins
features.description: Enable Markdown rendering plugins as documented for Joplin.
actions: toggle the individual renderer plugins (for example KaTeX maths, Mermaid diagrams, footnotes, tables, task lists, abbreviations, sub/superscript, mark and typographer)

features.name: Install and manage Joplin plugins
features.description: Install and manage Joplin plugins as documented for Joplin.
actions: browse or search the plugin repository
use the toggle to enable or disable an installed plugin

features.name: Configure note behaviour defaults
features.description: Configure note behaviour defaults as documented for Joplin.
actions: set options such as the default editor, sort order, whether completed to-dos are shown, whether note counts are displayed and whether new notes get the geolocation

features.name: Export a JEX/RAW backup or share note data
features.description: Export a JEX/RAW backup or share note data as documented for Joplin.
actions: choose the export format (for example JEX archive)

features.name: Import notes from a file
features.description: Import notes from a file as documented for Joplin.
actions: select the JEX or Markdown file

features.name: Send a note to another app
features.description: Send a note to another app as documented for Joplin.
actions: choose the target app in the Android share sheet

features.name: Create a note from another app via the share sheet
features.description: Create a note from another app via the share sheet as documented for Joplin.
actions: In any app, tap Share on the text, link or image
select the destination notebook if prompted
confirm; a new note is created

features.name: View note properties
features.description: View note properties as documented for Joplin.
actions: read the created and updated times, the source URL, the location and the internal ID

features.name: View the synchronisation status and log
features.description: View the synchronisation status and log as documented for Joplin.
actions: tap "Synchronisation status" to see counts of items and encryption state, or open Tools

features.name: Check for application updates
features.description: Check for application updates as documented for Joplin.
actions: follow the prompt if a newer version is available (available on non-store builds)
